With reference to the Regulation 30 & 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and the above mentioned subject, we wish to inform you that the Board of Directors in its Meeting held on Wednesday, 12th August, 2026 has approved the Un-Audited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter ended 30th June, 2026. In this regard, please find enclosed herewith the following:
1. Un-Audited Financial Results along with the Statement of Un-Audited Assets and Liabilities for the quarter ended 30th June, 2026.

2. To take on record the Limited Review Report along with modified/unmodified opinion on the Financial Results for the quarter ended 30th June, 2026
NEWSSUB: Disclosure Under Regulation 30 & 33 Of Securities And Exchange Board Of India (Listing Obligations Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015
